estimate_note: 20s overhead + 2 * shots * sum(circuit duration + explicitly set repetition delay); heuristic, not guarantee
budget_value_kind: Uncommitted lower bound after reserving caps of known pending jobs; submission checks again.

statistics_plan.comparison: Same-job original baseline; postselected candidate additionally compares with the frozen same-layout baseline.
statistics_plan.selection: Candidate and both confirmation stages frozen before either new job; both replications must pass.
statistics_plan.scope: Independent confirmation among tested configurations, not proof of global optimality.
